author: Sword088
quote:
I am on a launch model PS5. I enjoy high framerates when I play games on my PC, but I am not a framerate snob. I have played many console games at 30 fps. Most of the time GTA VI is playable, but only barely. There absolutely are times it is genuinely unplayable. If there are lots of NPCs around, or on screen, and an explosion happens the framerate counter on my TV says it drops to 12 fps. Which happens to be half the "CiNeMaTiC" 24 fps it usually hovers around. 30 fps isn't consistently achievable for this game. Instead, it is a nice surprise that rarely drops by to visit, and never stays long. 

The good: Flat out, the shooting and visuals are a massive improvement over GTA V. 

The bad: everything else. 
They ripped out half of what made Grand Theft Auto GTA in the first place and what they replaced it with is boring and lame. Gone is the arcadey crime sandbox where nothing was off limits and everything was on the table. In its place a skin-walker wearing the flesh a GTA game and using the mechanics from RDR2 tries to gaslight you into thinking GTA was always a life sim dating game with crime on the side. You can not commit crime in your neighborhood. You can now only carry two hand guns and two long guns on your person cause "ReAliSm". You are not always able to carjack a car. The train stops for dead bodies now. You can no longer shoot up some clubs, it forces your gun down if you try to aim inside from outside. You can no longer run some NPCs over, they are either invincible or the game forces your car to brake. The NPC and vehicle reactions seem noticeable worse. They removed prostitutes from the game set in Florida because of the poorly executed "Bonnie and Clyde" storyline. The supporting cast of characters are unfunny and not very interesting. The male main character has the personality of a soggy piece of toast. "Yeah. Okay, sure." Is his entire range. The Female character is your classic toxica girlboss. They try to make her the sympathetic tragic character and at least for me that doesn't work. It happens to fast and doesn't develop naturally. Additionally every new piece of information you uncover about her makes her more reprehensible and undercuts the sympathy angle they were trying to go for. All of the menial, overly realistic tasks are Jason doing boring things for Lucia. There are no tasks for Lucia to do things for Jason. She does not reciprocate. 

Ultimately GTA VI is a vapid and soulless GTA game. Do not buy this game to play on the launch PS5, Xbox X or S. Do not by a PS5 pro for 1500 to play this game. Wait for this game to go on sale. Play it on PC or wait for the next gen consoles depending on the price they launch at. Hopefully modders can fix this game. Sad to see a storied franchise fall so far.

author: Sword088
quote: I had a great time playing this game. I love build crafting and you can make almost anything work in this game. There is a wide selection of classes, armour, weapons, spells, scrolls, and throwables. I think the story is pretty good. There are lots of creative routes you can take. The first act is clearly the most polished, but they are all enjoyable. My only complaint is the companions are a little too horny. Also, I didn't dock any points for this, but I think the turn-based combat will cause some people to bounce off it. I understand DnD IS turn-based, but I think action combat has just proven to be the more popular choice for most video games.

author: Sword088
quote: A near perfect masterpiece. Lots of usable builds. There is tons of armour, weapons, ashes of war, spells, and talismans to play around with. The characters are interesting. The world is beautiful, horrifying, and massive without loosing interesting details. 90% of the time if you see a place in the distance you can go there. The only two nit picks I have are: 1. Only a few of the dungeons are really worth exploring after the first playthough. However, I'm not sure if there is a better solution for video games with dungeons that doesn't introduce its own problems to put up with. 2. Some of the lowest teir bosses are repeated too often and their movesets/powers aren't varied enough to justify appearing as many times as they do.  There is always a cost to having an open world and in Elden Ring it is a small price to pay for what you get. I have thousands of hours into this game across both PC and Playstation. The Co-op mod on PC is great.
